name: B2EMO
description: B2EMO, also known as Bee-two or Bee, was a B2 groundmech salvage assist unit who spent years in the service of the Andor family. An old boxy droid with red plating and a black main sensor, Bee could roll on his wheels over a range of terrains. He used his numerous tools to help members of the human family salvage scrap, and after the end of their scavenging days, he continued to serve as a helper and faithful companion to the family in their home in Ferrix City.
